findings.quoted_text: Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to Reed's any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity (or the maximum period permitted by Applicable Laws and Regulations) and Reed's accepts such assignment.

Company acknowledges and agrees that all Intellectual Property created by Company, its affiliates, representatives, or agents in connection with or resulting from any work or services related to the Products, including the Deliverables ("Work Product"), but excluding the Neutral Alcohol Beverage Base and excluding the Company's general know-how and independently developed production processes not specifically related to the Products, have been specially ordered and commissioned by Reed's, are works-made-for-hire from the moment of creation and that all such Work Product is and will be the sole and exclusive property of Reed's.

Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to [PARTY_D] any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity (or the maximum period permitted by Applicable Laws and Regulations) and [PARTY_D] accepts such assignment.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers immediately upon creation via a present assignment, rather than waiting until you are paid in full.
findings.suggested_change: Upon full payment of all amounts due under this Agreement, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in the Deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: Company acknowledges and agrees that all Intellectual Property created by Company, its affiliates, representatives, or agents in connection with or resulting from any work or services related to the Products, including the Deliverables ("Work Product"), but excluding the Neutral Alcohol Beverage Base and excluding the Company's general know-how and independently developed production processes not specifically related to the Products, have been specially ordered and commissioned by [PARTY_D], are works-made-for-hire from the moment of creation and that all such Work Product is and will be the sole and exclusive property of [PARTY_D].
findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership of your work passes to the client upon creation before you have been paid, which means you lose your leverage if payment is delayed.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, all right, title, and interest in and to the Deliverables shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on the immediate assignment of rights, ownership transfers upon creation rather than upon full payment; please update this to: "Upon full payment of all amounts due under this Agreement, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in the Deliverables." - Regarding the relevant clause concerning works-made-for-hire, intellectual property passes before payment is received; please modify it to: "Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, all right, title, and interest in and to the Deliverables shall transfer to the Client." Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
